skill.summary: Email automation flows — welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, browse abandonment

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial beta release of the shopify-email-flows skill.
- Provides expert guidance and actionable frameworks for common Shopify email automations: welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, and browse abandonment.
- Offers store setup analysis, step-by-step implementation plans, and tool/app recommendations with pros/cons.
- Focuses on strategic advice; does not integrate directly with Shopify APIs.
- Tailors recommendations to your business stage and highlights key KPIs for tracking success.
